desc: Implement the full solution in Python: read input, compute first/last occurrences, define the counting logic for valid $(L,R)$ pairs, iterate through values $x$ to sum contributions, and print the result.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.

Implement the gap-based counting logic: For each $x$, find gaps of $x-1$, and for each gap $[a, b]$, count subsegments $[L, R] \subseteq [a, b]$ that contain at least one $x$. Sum these counts for all $x$.
Handle edge cases and ensure $O(N)$ complexity.
Finalize and run the corrected code on samples.
